b1-swallowed-sec.heading: Swallowed Too Much?
b1-swallowed-sec.for: a friend whose companion swallowed too much of something works out what kind of overdose it is, then whether to give activated charcoal, and who else to ask; the first two paragraphs and the last paragraph's first, second and last sentences are the writer's own and stay; read the one new sentence, which begins "But I wouldn't ask them about charcoal"
b1-swallowed-sec.moment: you are the friend of someone who swallowed too much of a plant medicine a few hours ago; you have activated charcoal in your bag and a phone, and you are deciding what to do next

asis-rescue-sec.heading: My Acute Rescue Remedies (the section's opening, before its list of remedies)
asis-rescue-sec.for: a reader learns what the list of rescue remedies that follows is for: acute trouble where the body, the gut or the brain is what is going wrong, as against a mainly emotional crisis
asis-rescue-sec.moment: you are sitting with a friend on a psychedelic who has diarrhea and nausea and says their mind is going crazy; you are deciding whether this is something to talk them through or something to treat with a remedy
